body:
There are many smart ways to add and subtract. 🧠
Make a ten: 9 + 4 is 9 + 1 + 3, so it is 10 + 3 = 13.
Use doubles: 6 + 6 = 12, so 6 + 7 = 13.
Think addition to subtract: 13 - 5 is the number that makes 5 + __ = 13.
The equal sign means "is the same as".
In this unit we will try each way and pick our favorites.
title: Smart Ways to Add and Subtract
